layers._comment: The POIs 口岸模式 is ABOUT. Before this the mode drew only camera dots: three panels of queue and ferry times with nothing on the map saying which crossings they referred to — the panel-to-map link was missing in the one mode where the map should lead. Positions come from data/control_points.json (reference data with a validation trail: each coordinate checked against an official anchor and rejected beyond 1.5km, which caught four wrong lookups). The popup joins the LIVE queue reading from the trigger state, so it answers the panel's question rather than restating the name. 深圳灣 has no coordinate — it is resolved at district level instead of being given a confident wrong pin.

layers._title_note: MEASURED 2026-09-24: the previous title 停水位置（大廈／街道）＋受影響地區 was 17 characters and the LAYERS control is 230px wide, so it ellipsised mid-word to 停水位置（大廈／街道）＋受… — a layer name the reader could not finish. Shortened to fit. The full description lives in _comment below, which is where detail belongs.
layers._comment: TWO things on one toggle, deliberately: geocoded PINS on each affected address (a point layer added in overlays.ts from the collector's ALS lookup) over a red TINT of the districts those addresses fall in. Cyrus 2026-09-24: 'Layers District with water suspension should refering to Panel 水務署 臨時停水通知 showing the affected locations by geocoding' — before this the layer tinted a whole 18-district polygon for an outage that was often one building, so a single 牛頭角道 notice turned all of 觀塘區 red. Pins are two-tone: alert red for 食水 (drinking water, the life-safety case) and amber for 鹹水 (flushing water). A notice the geocoder could not resolve still contributes its district, so nothing disappears silently.

The 'aircraft' layer definition was withdrawn from the SHIPPED set 2026-09-23 because adsb.fi/adsb.lol block Cloudflare egress IPs, so it could only ever error in production. Kept out of layers.json rather than left in and unreferenced, because an unreferenced layer is not validated by any vertical and would rot silently. To restore: re-add { id: 'aircraft', source: 'adsb_fi_hk', render: 'status_grid', geom: 'point', symbol: 'plane', ... } and the rail entry in main.ts. The generic point renderer, the adapter and registerGlyphs('plane') are all untouched.
